notes.title: Badiya Alpha 1.9.7 is now Live! First Person Camera, Ultra-Wide Support
notes.notes:
Hello everyone

Badiya Alpha 1.9.7 is available now and it brings with it new features, bug fixes and performance optimizations:


[h1]* First Person Perspective:[/h1]
You can now play the whole game in first person as an option. You can press "C" or "L3" on the controller at any time.
This adds a new way to experience the world of Badiya.

[h1]* Ultra-Wide Screen Support:[/h1]
The game now supports ultra wide resolutions with the 21:9 aspect ratio.

[h1]* Performance Optimization:[/h1]
We solved several "stutters" that used to happen whenever the auto save is called as well as in POIs. The game should feel much smoother in this regard.
The game now also supports impostors for all art assets, which are 3D billboards that receive lighting and shadows and should provide a nice boost in performance.

[h1]* Bug Fixes:[/h1]
We fixed several bugs related to saving/loading of items stored in chests/vehicles/camels.


[h1]* Next Step: The Horse Update[/h1]
The next updat Alpha 1.9.8 is going to be the "HORSE UPDATE" which will feature a full rewritten horse riding system with features such as:

[list]
[*] New Horse Models, textures, breeds and optional accessories such as saddles.
[*] New animation set.
[*] Ability to jump over low obstacles while on a horse.
[*] Ability to aim and shoot with any weapon while on top of a horse.
[*] Ability to hold any item while on a horse such as torches.
[*] AI (civilians and enemies) will be able to ride horses as well both inside POIs (villages, tents, camps) and in the open desert as roaming convoys.
[*] Enemy Bandits may launch raids on the villages or bedouin camps you happen to be in, and at that point you can either flee or stay and fight with the civilians. 
[/list]

As always, looking forward to your feedback. let us know what you think and what you are looking for next in the world of Badiya.

Best Regards from the whole Semaphore team,
Ahmad Jadallah (@AhmadJadallah)
Director of Development
Semaphore (@SemaphoreLab)

notes.title: Badiya: Battle Royale is Launched
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We would like to introduce you to a new Badiya experience that is joining the family. So Badiya is now two products:

[b]1- Badiya: Desert Survival:[/b] This is the Survival RPG game you all know about which is currently in Early Access on PC and is on track for completion and full release on Windows/PS4 and Xbox One as planned.

[b]2-Badiya: Battle Royale: [/b] Is a fast paced multiplayer battle royale game based on the world of "Badiya: Desert Survival". While "Badiya: Desert Survival" focuses on the single player Survival RPG experience, the Battle Royale entry puts the player in a 100 player experience where a sandstorm is ever closing from all directions and your goal is to be the last person alive.

[b]NOTE: "Badiya: Battle Royale" is built using Unreal Engine 4 and uses the majority of content and environment from the main game. The project has its own team so that it doesn't affect the development of "Badiya Desert Survival".[/b]

[h1]LAUNCH TRAILER:[/h1]
[previewyoutube=6kprz2JWCHQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]FEATURES:[/h1]
[list]
[*] A detailed environment filled with several points of interest including: Bedouin Camps, Villages, Ancient Ruins, Bandit Camps, Oil Refineries, Military Bases, Ranches and Crashed Airplane Sites, all filled with loot.
[*] A variety of period accurate weapons ranging from handguns, rifles, shotguns to sniper rifles.
[*] Support for Solo mode at launch, Duo and Squad Modes will follow later.
[*] Available as a start on iOS and Android. Windows, Mac, PS4 and Xbox One are planned for the future.
[*] Cross-play support with other platforms in the same match.
[*] Available in both English and Arabic.
[/list]


[h1]DOWNLOAD:[/h1]
[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/badiya-battle-royale/id1459509089?ls=1]Apple Appstore
[/url]
[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.semaphorelab.badiyaBattleRoyale]Google Play[/url]


[h1]WHAT ABOUT PC?
[/h1]
We want to bring "Badiya Battle Royale" to a wider audience on Steam. While we have the game fully playable on PC, the issue is how to find a viable business model that can cover the cost of multiplayer servers. On mobile this is handled through video ads that are shown before matches start but this can't be applied on PC to our knowledge. We do plan on having cosmetic in-app purchases for clothes but that is still further down the line. Please let us know your suggestions for this situation.

[h1]BADIYA: DESERT SURVIVAL UPDATES:
[/h1]
Work is underway on Alpha 1.9.7 and the speed boost to performance is looking great. We are fixing some bugs and polishing the new (optional) first person perspective to provide a good experience in all gameplay scenarios. We will update you as soon as we get closer to the release.

Best Regards,
Ahmad Jadallah
Director of Development
Semaphore

semaphorelab.com

notes.title: Badiya Alpha 1.9.6 is now LIVE! The Falcon Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Badiya Alpha 1.9.6 is now live and features many fixes and improvements to the gameplay experience with a main feature addition of Falcons.

[b]* FALCONS:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26712043/30c3d531a9398e5d5d9b99821ccf54ceb94368ad.jpg[/img]

Falcons are an integral part of the Bedouin culture and are used mainly for hunting.
If you recall our reveal trailer, the very first segment was of a falcon unleashed by its owner to hunt a rabbit. Now we implemented this in the gameplay mix.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26712043/354b1ea15a16213d3dbb0fe6d382d1015f4c5468.jpg[/img]

Through the Falcon Merchant found in Bedouin Camps, you can now buy or sell falcons of different breeds and value (uniquely named) and unleash them and take control of them in the sky. You can use them to Tag targets and either hurt/distract them if they are a big enemy or kill them if they are smaller preys like rabbits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26712043/0ff097ed25d23c5c1f433bedcfe17edce8d6081a.jpg[/img]

You can also use the new Tagging feature to mark and track potential targets for the player. This tagging system will be later expanded upon in the following Alpha to support Scopes and Binoculars as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26712043/2377d1d945a1e3826e71f9ad91a8009e55cbfbaf.jpg[/img]

Falcons can be equipped from the new "Animals" sub-category in the inventory and this will open the way for adding future companion animals such as owned horses, camels and greyhounds.

Once you equip a falcon, enter aiming mode and press fire to unleash the falcon and take control of it.

 [b]* GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]
[*] We now show the possible actions you can do when you are riding a horse/camel or a vehicle or flying a falcon on the left side of the screen. This brings attention to features that can be overlooked by the player such as the ability to turn on the lights of a vehicle or that camels have an inventory on them.
[*] You can now switch the camera shoulder even when not aiming a weapon (Thanks to @Nine_K for the suggestion)
[*] Upon death, a dialog window will be shown explaining what will happen next (permadeath, reloading with some items missing, etc..) depending on what the user selected.
[*] More wood from trees
[*] Ensure there are two water wells in every village.
[*] Fixed issues related to the saving/loading system.
[*] Adjusted snow intensity so that the heaviest level is not overly snowy, mimicking the real life look of snow in the desert.
[*] When it does snow, snow will last for half a day before dissolving/melting.
[*] Several other bug fixes and quality of life improvements. 
[/list]

 [b]* COMING UP NEXT:[/b]
Alpha 1.9.7 will bring with it the following features. 
[list]
[*] First Person Perspective Option
[*] Scopes
[*] Binoculars
[*] Military Sniper Rifle
[*] Jezail Sniper Rifle
[*] Snake
[*] Scorpion
[/list]

As always, looking forward to your feedback. let us know what you think and what you are looking for next in the world of Badiya.

Best Regards from the whole Semaphore team,
Ahmad Jadallah (@AhmadJadallah)
Director of Development

notes.title: Badiya Alpha 1.9.5 is now Live! A New Badiya Experience Awaits
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Badiya Alpha 1.9.5 is now live and it features several game changing features that will take your survival experience to the next level. The following features were added:

[h1]* PLAY THE WAY YOU WANT[/h1]
You can now choose from the following modes that fit different play styles:

[b]- Exploration:[/b] Made for more casual players. There are no survival meters to worry about. You can only lose health by getting hurt by bullets, melee attacks, fire or animal bites. (Health and Stamina are the only things you worry about). If you die and load from last checkpoint you don't incur any penalty, you keep your inventory as it was when you died.

[b]- Survival:[/b] The balanced mode for playing the game. If you die, you will re-spawn at the nearest visited friendly POI. You also lose 30% of the items you had on you but they are kept in a chest box where you died, so you can go there and reclaim the contents again if you wish. The chest will expire after 24 hours.

[b]- Hardcore:[/b] Like Survival mode, but has only one save slot that is deleted if you die (permadeath)

[h1]* START MULTIPLE GAMES[/h1]
Now when you start a new game you get to assign a specific slot for it that will be used for saving. This means you can start different journeys with different play styles (a villain, a hero, an explorer, a camper, etc...)

[h1]* UNIQUE NAMES FOR PEOPLE AND PLACES[/h1]
When you used to discover POIs you used to see a generic name like "YOU DISCOVERED A VILLAGE". And in quest objectives you also had generic names like "Deliver meat to CIVILIAN in BEDOUIN CAMP". 

We now have a system for generating unique names for POIs and for people mentioned in quest objectives which gives them more realism. Those names will also be shown on the map and compass on top of the screen.


[h1]* NEW PROGRESS SAVING SYSTEM[/h1]
[b]Saving:[/b]
We now save on the following events:
-Saving at Lean-to or other sleep location
-Visiting a friendly POI
-Quitting the game

[b]Loading:[/b]
-When loading the game, start player at either the lean-to or last friendly POI, whichever was visited LAST. 
-If you want to load the game, you have to go to main menu, click on Continue and choose the profile slot you want.

[h1]* NO MORE STARTER KITS:[/h1]
Starter kits that you choose from (Bedouin, Explorer, Aviator, Soldier, Bandit) were meant to give you a head start in the world of Badiya with a proper clothing setup and some items such as tools, a weapon, and some ammo. However, they took away from the survival experience and so we wanted to give you that feeling of building yourself from scratch and so now you will start with only your basic thobe and pants on.


[h1]* SALVAGING IS BACK![/h1]
Previously you were able to salvage any item from the inventory, but that created an imbalance in the game where you could salvage an item quickly, get many sub items, sell them and break the economy. Now we tied the salvaging function to the crafting station that you have to build  first.


[h1]* BUILD ANYWHERE, EVEN INSIDE POIS[/h1]
We previously restricted building to outside POIs as to avoid having our AI characters getting stuck on the stuff you build. Now we account for that and obstacle avoidance will get better in upcoming releases.


[h1]* CRASHES ARE FIXED[/h1]
For a while there has been a bug that causes a memory leak and a crash when playing the game which has been hard to track and fix but now we believe it is properly fixed and there shouldn't be any more crashes with the game from what we see in our tests.


[h1]* ONE TIME UNITS SETUP[/h1]
Currently every time you start a new game, you are asked to select the units you want for weight, distance and temperature. Now they will be asked of you only in the language selection screen that you see when you first run the game for the first time. After that you can change them from the "Units" panel in "Options" menu. 

[h1]* CONDITION OF LOOTABLE ITEMS[/h1]
Lootable items (Weapons, Clothes, Food, etc...) from any dead body will now be at low condition and that should reflect in their salvagability and their selling price. This solves the issue of getting rich and well armed quickly by just clearing a single POI as the items you pick now from your enemies will be of low value/use.

[H1]* REPAIRING ITEMS[/H1]
You can now use a processing station to repair the condition of different items in your inventory. We will very soon add a Repair NPC in villages who will do the same as well. We will also add a weapon jamming property so you have to maintain your weapons.

[H1]* SMALL FIXES[/H1]
- Takedowns on enemies are now assigned to the second interaction button. This is done to avoid doing a takedown attack on civilians by mistake instead of interacting with them.
- Fixed an issue where you couldn't pickup clay objects that were on the clay patch near wells.
- Fixed an issue where you could potentially get stuck in a loop while trying to open a chestbox that is near a wall.
- Fixed the issue of being unable to run (game tells you that you are encumbered) even though you are not.

We will be following this release with a few hot fixes over the next 10 days to solve any potential issues and to add some small fixes.

As always, looking forward to your feedback.

Best Regards from the whole Semaphore team,
Ahmad Jadallah (@AhmadJadallah)
Director of Development
Semaphore (@SemaphoreLab)

notes.title: Alpha 1.9 is now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Badiya Alpha 1.9 is here and it contains the following new features/improvements as well as many bug fixes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26712043/fbecc9f2a98775efca9098fdef2384ddfdc4bd61.jpg[/img]

[h1]* VISUALS:[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Weather, Time of Day and Cloud System. Clouds now look much better and perform faster than before and are properly affected/shaded by sunlight.
[*] New Post Processing System that gives the game a more grounded cinematic look.
[*] New Volumetric Lighting System that shows the sunlight passing through tree leaves and objects and is similar to the one found in many AAA titles. This feature is enabled on ULTRA quality preset.
[*] New Contact Shadows System that adds more shadowing details on objects. This feature is enabled on ULTRA quality preset.
[*] New PCSS system (Percentage Closer Soft Shadows) so that shadows get softer the farther they are from the source object. This feature is enabled on ULTRA quality preset.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26712043/960a3d0bed60dd97461bff2218bf4dd30c0fa272.jpg[/img]
[h1]* ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Crowd Reaction System (You can aim at civilians and they will cower and run away if they are unarmed and will trigger a chain reaction of other civilians running away. If they are armed they will draw their weapons and aim at you but will only shoot if you open fire.)
[*] You can now kill/hit/run over crowds in camps and cities, the punishment now is that you risk a fire fight with the armed civilians. In future releases the goal is to have a crime and reputation system that will make your actions known in nearby POIs and therefore your treatment by the locals will differ based on your reputation. A crime system will also be added so that lock picking chests and taking horses/camels without paying their owners will be considered a crime that the crowds will react to and will affect your reputation if seen.
[*] You can use a mount or a vehicle and run over characters, they will fall and stand up again if the hit is not lethal but will die otherwise.
[*] Enemy AI Encounters Improvement (Enemies get out of POIs, better obstacle avoidance and reactions, better awareness of player position)
[*] Enemies Awareness meter, each enemy has several states of awareness. An indicator will show up on them that starts filling up the closer they are to detecting you. This meter is tracked for nearby enemies so you can better judge your next move.
[/list]


[h1]* POI HOSTILITY:[/h1]
Points of Interest now have different hostility levels you can move between.
[list]
[*] Neutral: Colored Orange on the map and compass.
[*] Hostile: Colored Red on the map and compass.
[*] Cleared: Colored White on the map and compass.
[/list]

If you are in a neutral POI like a village for example and you commit a crime (currently defined as murder, will be expanded later to include theft and disturbing of peace or vandalism) then the armed civilians in this POI will start shooting you (even if you leave the place and come back later). The POI level will move from Neutral to Hostile and the only other level it can move to is Cleared once you killed the armed civilians in it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26712043/d7330c4d9873e2e5746a227371b05ef6a837eac5.jpg[/img]
[h1]* QUEST SYSTEM:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Quests in the Quest Menu are now divided to Main, Side and Finished Quests
[*] If you take a new quest while there is an existing active quest, you have the option of holding "E" to track the new quest you just took.
[/list]

[h1]* WHAT'S NEXT?:[/h1]

We will release bug fix patches (1.9.1 , 1.9.2 etc..) through out the next month then will continue on Alpha 2.0, some of the planned features are the following (subject to change)

[b]* TERRAINS:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Terrain Generation System
[*] New terrain shading system with tessellation and object blending
[*] Several Biomes featuring a unique (Look, Loot, Resources, POI Types, Animal Types, Tree Types, Vegetation Density, Enemies, Quests) for each with seamless blending between them. Biomes include (Arid, Dunes, Mountains, Canyons, Hills and others)
[/list]

[b]* PERFORMANCE:[/b]
[list]
[*] Massive boost in terrain generation speed and loading times
[*] Vegetation and objects Instancing
[*] Dynamic Occlusion Culling (Objects behind a wall or a building will not be rendered for better performance)
[*] Imposter System (Very far objects will be represented as sprites for better performance)
[/list]

[b]* HORSE GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ability to shoot on top of horse or camel
[*] Mount ownership system where you can't just take a horse/camel but you have to buy it from its owner or steal it (risking others shooting at you)
[*] Whistle to call horses you own 
[*] AI Can ride mounts and vehicles and shoot from them
[*] AI Can patrol POIs on mounts and vehicles
[*] AI Can fall from their mounts when you shoot them or shoot their mounts. They can do the same to you!
[/list]

[b]* LIVING WORLD:[/b]
[*] Wild animals can make you fall from horses/camels you ride
[*] Occasional Raids on POIs you are in. Imagine a group of bandits attacking a village or camp that you happen to be in. In which case you can stay and fight with the civilians or flee the place. Both actions will affect your reputation meter.
[*] Convoys of military vehicles moving between POIs. You can raid them or risk getting attacked by them.
[*] Armed/unarmed civilian(s) traveling between POIs. You can raid them or trade/interact with them.
[/list]

[b]* GENERAL GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[*] Hostile POIs will send bounty hunters after you if you commit a crime in them until you pay the bounty or kill all armed NPCs in them.
[*] A new POI alert state if you disturb the peace but not commit a major crime (Example: punching someone, killing a chicken, breaking property) which will see them refusing to give you quests or trading with you (or selling you at high prices while buying at lower prices)
[*] Unique names for towns, camps and NPCs so that quest givers have a better quest description for you.
[*] Salvage function is coming back and can be performed through a salvage station you build.
[*] Falcon/Scopes/binoculars with ability to tag enemies
[*] Armor system
[*] Gain weight when you eat more, lose weight when you don't eat for a while
[*] Multiple layers of clothing cause overheating and lowering stamina
[*] Items Wheel
[*] Whistle to Attract enemies to investigate your location
[*] Throwable items/grenades with a helper arc. These can be used to point enemy's attention to a particular spot which allows you move to another spot.
[/list]

[b]* SYSTEMS:[/b]
[*] Progression System (XP, Levels, Skill Points, Skills to unlock)
[*] Tutorial
[*] Story Mode and an end game
[/list]


As usual, please report any bugs you encounter on the "Bug Reporting Forum" and send us an email to feedback@semaphorelab.com

Best Regards,
Ahmad Jadallah (@ahmadjadallah)
Director of Development
Semaphore Lab (@semaphorelab)

notes.title: Alpha 1.9 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

So we are done with the new features for Alpha 1.9 and are currently in the testing phase which we expect will continue through the week ending Sunday December 9th. If we get done with testing before that we will release it right away but we wouldn't want to release with bugs that will spoil your experience.

[H1]Why is Alpha 1.9 taking so long?[/H1]
A major focus of Alpha 1.9 is crowd reaction and interactivity. This means that every single character you meet in Badiya now will no longer be just a passive NPC but will actually react to you threatening them with a weapon, punching them, hitting them with a horse or camel and  hitting them with a vehicle or a tank. Not only that, but others around this particular NPC who witness this act will take notice and react accordingly by either engaging in the fight if they are armed or running away if they are not!

As you might guess, getting this to look and work properly takes a lot of effort and is subject to bugs and that's why we were working hard on getting it to work as expected (with more room for improvements in later versions as well)

We can't wait to get this release in your hands and thank you very much for your love for the game. You guys deserve the best and we are working hard to deliver that to you.

Best Regards,
Ahmad Jadallah
Director of Development
Semaphore

notes.title: Alpha 1.7.1 is now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Notes: 
- If you like what we are doing please consider giving us a positive review in the game reviews section.
- Installing the game on a SSD drive is highly recommended for the best experience.
- The game defaults to "Medium" quality settings but you can change that from the Options-Graphics menu.

Alpha 1.7.1 is here and it aims to provide a more polished experience to the game across the following areas:

[h1]* Performance and Stability:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Major performance boost across all quality levels.
[*] Overall game size went from 10 GB to 6 GB.
[*] Options menu now offers full control over vSync and Frame Rate limit. By default both of them will be set to off but you should try to set frame rate limit to highest stabe number you are getting. For example if you keep getting 60-70 frames per second then it's best to set the limit to 60 so you get a constant stable 60. At that point you may consider turning vSync to 1 Frames to avoid screen tearing if you are getting it (but vSync has a performance cost so check if it's worth turning on or not).
[*] Added additional graphical options such as "Anisotropic Filtering", "Soft Particles" and "View Distances"
[*] Several bug fixes related to the quest system, map, fast travel, Saving/Loading and building system.
[/list]

[h1]* Gameplay:[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now cook meals in addition to items in through the "Cooking Station".
[*] You can now build ground torches for your camp.
[/list]

[h1]* User Interface:[/h1]
[list]
[*] On Controllers, the X button on Xbox Controller and Square button on PS4 controller are now used as the main interaction button instead of "Y/Triangle" to make it more in line with other open world games.
[*] If you are using a PS4 controller, you will now see R1/R2/L1/L2 icons instead of "LB,RB,LT,RT".
[*] When you salvage an item in your inventory you will get a confirmation dialog so you don't do it by mistake.
[*] Removed "Salvage All" function from containers "chests/bodies/animals".
[*] Easier switching between the inventories whenever two panels are shown on screen with a clear indicator to which panel is currently active.
[*] Sub menu navigation through the keyboard now uses "z" and "x" instead of "[" and "]"
[/list]

[h1]* Upcoming Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Armor (Head, Body, Foot) for both player and Enemies
[*] Enemy AI Improvements
[*] Gunplay aiming/feel Improvements
[*] Gameplay balancing and improvements to avoid getting overpowered early in the game.
[*] Loot boxes that are in dangerous places or require lock picking will have suitably valuable loot while loot boxes in safe locations or that are unlocked wont have valuable stuff.
[*] Merchant Inventory specialization: Fruit merchant, weapon merchant, Cloth merchant as opposed to the random items that currently exists.
[*] Multiple POI Difficulties
[*] Game wide items balancing (Prices, Effect)
[*] Temperature effect on player (Extreme heat and extreme cold)
[*] Food intake to have an effect on the player (Getting fatter or thinner)
[*] Enemy AI will have lower probability of dropping weapons
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 1.7 is now Live!
notes.notes:
Badiya Alpha 1.7 is here and it marks our one year anniversary on Steam Early Access and our biggest release yet. This is a game changer!

[b]Notes: 
- If you like what we are doing please consider giving us a positive review in the game reviews section.
- Installing the game on a SSD drive is highly recommended for the best experience.
- The game defaults to "Medium" quality settings but you can change that from the Options-Graphics menu.
[/b]


[h1][b]* FEATURES:[/b][/h1]
[b]- Map System with Fog of War:[/b]
In the player menu we now added a new Map section that shows the game's map (also accessible by pressing M on the keyboard).

You can find the usual functions such as panning, setting destination marker, center on player, etc...

[b]- New POI Compass:[/b]
On top of the screen you can now see a new compass that shows you the direction and distance to each point of interest (will be presented by a question mark if it's not discovered yet, otherwise it will show you the POI icon).

Note that this compass only shows up if you have the Compass item in your inventory which now comes with all the different starter kits at the beginning of the game (Except the None preset which assumes you want to start with absolutely nothing in inventory. In which case you can acquire, buy or craft the compass).

[b]- Quest System with several types of quests:[/b]
This is perhaps the biggest addition to this release. You can now find Quest Giver NPCs marked with an exclamation mark on top of their heads. Interacting with them will show you the Quest dialog where you can find details about the quest, description, reward and the required objectives at which point you can accept or refuse the quest.

There is an infinite number of quests in the game and they are of several types that will require you to perform different tasks and will leave it up to you to discover them. We will be adding more quest types with every new release.

Once you accept a Quest you can inspect them in the Quests section in the player menu. From there you can track the different quests and show their objective location on map if they have any. The currently tracked quest will appear in the top right part of the screen so you can now what objectives to pursue.

Quest objectives will also appear on the POI compass on top of the screen.


[b]- New terrain generation system with better distribution of Points of Interest:[/b]
Now there will always be new places to discover the more you explore. We separated our Points of Interest to large ones with mini POIs scattered in between. 

The new system ensures that there wont be repetition in POIs when you are exploring the world (Unless mandated by the design on purpose) and therefore there will always be something new for you to explore.

[b]- Ambient AI Improvements:[/b]
You will now see crowds talking to each other and to merchants
Crowds will now react to you aiming your weapons at them, if you continue raising your weapon they will attempt to run away. This is the base of a Crime and Reputation system that we will be adding later on which will make your actions toward factions affect your reputation with them and have gameplay consequences such as increasing your wanted level, the prices you get for trading and other features.

[b]- Fast Travel System:[/b]
We now have Caravans that contain fast travel NPCs (with a camel icon on top of them). Those NPCs will allow you to travel to bedouin camps or villages that you visited before.

Note that Fast Travel NPCs can also be found on other types of friendly POIs.

[b]- Steam Achievements:[/b]
You can now gain achievements for surviving longer in the game. We plan to add different types of achievements for the various game activities in upcoming updates.

[b]- Steam Trading Cards:[/b]
Those are coming up shortly. Stay tuned!

[h1][b]* CONTENT:[/b][/h1]
We added plenty of new points of interest to discover in this release. Raising the total to 30 so far and we plan to add more in the future:
[list]
[*]Sheep Herder
[*]Caravan
[*]Bandit Camp
[*]Explorer Camp
[*]Traveller Camp
[*]Hunter Camp
[*]Merchant Camp
[*]Iron Mine
[*]Gold Mine
[*]Copper Mine
[*]Stone Deposit
[*]Frankensence Tree Cluster
[*]Silktree Cluster
[*]Wheat Field
[*]Green Field (Rawdha)  
[*]Palm Farm
[*]Big Oasis
[/list]

[h1][b]* GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]The drop item button on the controller is now R3 (pressing the right thumb stick. While Pressing Circle/B button will close the inventory menu. 
[*]You can now build tents that look like the ones in the bedouin camp.
[*]You can now eat herbs (previously they were only used to craft medical potions).
[*]You can now chop down palm trees and collect wood, plant fibre and dates from them.
[*]Each animal type now has a unique hide item.
[*]You can now reload your weapon on a PS4/XBox One controller by pressing L3.
[*]Photo Mode now requires pressing L3+R3 sticks on the controller at the same time (if photo mode is enabled from the pause menu).
[*]Aiming Shoulder Switch is now done using L Alt key on the keyboard instead of the middle mouse button.
[/list]

[h1][b]* Graphics:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]New improved terrain textures: Game will now have a better desert look.
[*]PCSS: Shadows get softer the farther they are from the source object that is casting it like in real life. This feature is tied to the "Ultra" quality setting and can be disabled manually from the graphics menu if needed.
[*]Better look for Night time in terms of brightness and colors.
[*]Better Eye Adaptation and sunlight intensity so that the overall image isn't overly bright.
[/list]

[h1][b]* Numerous Bug Fixes:[/b][/h1]
We did a lot of bug fixing in different areas in the game. As usual if you encounter a crash or a bug, go to the game's folder and search for a file named "Output_log.txt" and send that to us on the email feedback@semaphorelab.com
This file tells us exactly what happened from the moment you ran the executable to when the crash or error happened and it will help us identify and fix the issue.

[h1][b]* Coming Up Next:[/b][/h1]
We will be releasing a few updates during the 1.7 life cycle that improve the gameplay, performance and any issues that need addressing. Some of the features to expect are;
Better combat AI behaviour
Better shooting mechanics
Difficulty level for hostile points of interest
Armor for enemy AI that is period accurate (also wearable by the player)
Gameplay balancing for item stats, merchant inventories and survival stats.

On behalf of the entire team at Semaphore. Thank you so much for a great first year on Steam Early Access. Our community is our fuel and you guys and girls are the best!

Ahmad Jadallah (@AhmadJadallah)
Director of Development
Semaphore (@SemaphoreLab)

On top of the screen you can now see a new compass that shows you the direction and distance to each point of interest (will be presented by a question mark if it's not discovered yet, otherwise it will show you the POI icon).

Note that this compass only shows up if you have the Compass item in your inventory which now comes with all the different starter kits at the beginning of the game (Except the None preset which assumes you want to start with absolutely nothing in inventory. In which case you can acquire, buy or craft the compass).

[b]- Quest System with several types of quests:[/b]
This is perhaps the biggest addition to this release. You can now find Quest Giver NPCs marked with an exclamation mark on top of their heads. Interacting with them will show you the Quest dialog where you can find details about the quest, description, reward and the required objectives at which point you can accept or refuse the quest.

There is an infinite number of quests in the game and they are of several types that will require you to perform different tasks and will leave it up to you to discover them. We will be adding more quest types with every new release.

Once you accept a Quest you can inspect them in the Quests section in the player menu. From there you can track the different quests and show their objective location on map if they have any. The currently tracked quest will appear in the top right part of the screen so you can now what objectives to pursue.

Quest objectives will also appear on the POI compass on top of the screen.


[b]- New terrain generation system with better distribution of Points of Interest:[/b]
Now there will always be new places to discover the more you explore. We separated our Points of Interest to large ones with mini POIs scattered in between. 

The new system ensures that there wont be repetition in POIs when you are exploring the world (Unless mandated by the design on purpose) and therefore there will always be something new for you to explore.

[b]- Ambient AI Improvements:[/b]
You will now see crowds talking to each other and to merchants
Crowds will now react to you aiming your weapons at them, if you continue raising your weapon they will attempt to run away. This is the base of a Crime and Reputation system that we will be adding later on which will make your actions toward factions affect your reputation with them and have gameplay consequences such as increasing your wanted level, the prices you get for trading and other features.

[b]- Fast Travel System:[/b]
We now have Caravans that contain fast travel NPCs (with a camel icon on top of them). Those NPCs will allow you to travel to bedouin camps or villages that you visited before.

Note that Fast Travel NPCs can also be found on other types of friendly POIs.

[b]- Steam Achievements:[/b]
You can now gain achievements for surviving longer in the game. We plan to add different types of achievements for the various game activities in upcoming updates.

[b]- Steam Trading Cards:[/b]
Those are coming up shortly. Stay tuned!

[h1][b]* CONTENT:[/b][/h1]
We added plenty of new points of interest to discover in this release. Raising the total to 30 so far and we plan to add more in the future:
[list]
[*]Sheep Herder
[*]Caravan
[*]Bandit Camp
[*]Explorer Camp
[*]Traveller Camp
[*]Hunter Camp
[*]Merchant Camp
[*]Iron Mine
[*]Gold Mine
[*]Copper Mine
[*]Stone Deposit
[*]Frankensence Tree Cluster
[*]Silktree Cluster
[*]Wheat Field
[*]Green Field (Rawdha)  
[*]Palm Farm
[*]Big Oasis
[/list]

[h1][b]* GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]The drop item button on the controller is now R3 (pressing the right thumb stick. While Pressing Circle/B button will close the inventory menu. 
[*]You can now build tents that look like the ones in the bedouin camp.
[*]You can now eat herbs (previously they were only used to craft medical potions).
[*]You can now chop down palm trees and collect wood, plant fibre and dates from them.
[*]Each animal type now has a unique hide item.
[*]You can now reload your weapon on a PS4/XBox One controller by pressing L3.
[*]Photo Mode now requires pressing L3+R3 sticks on the controller at the same time (if photo mode is enabled from the pause menu).
[*]Aiming Shoulder Switch is now done using L Alt key on the keyboard instead of the middle mouse button.
[/list]

[h1][b]* Graphics:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]New improved terrain textures: Game will now have a better desert look.
[*]PCSS: Shadows get softer the farther they are from the source object that is casting it like in real life. This feature is tied to the "Ultra" quality setting and can be disabled manually from the graphics menu if needed.
[*]Better look for Night time in terms of brightness and colors.
[*]Better Eye Adaptation and sunlight intensity so that the overall image isn't overly bright.
[/list]

[h1][b]* Numerous Bug Fixes:[/b][/h1]
We did a lot of bug fixing in different areas in the game. As usual if you encounter a crash or a bug, go to the game's folder and search for a file named "Output_log.txt" and send that to us on the email feedback@semaphorelab.com
This file tells us exactly what happened from the moment you ran the executable to when the crash or error happened and it will help us identify and fix the issue.

[h1][b]* Coming Up Next:[/b][/h1]
We will be releasing a few updates during the 1.7 life cycle that improve the gameplay, performance and any issues that need addressing. Some of the features to expect are;
Better combat AI behaviour
Better shooting mechanics
Difficulty level for hostile points of interest
Armor for enemy AI that is period accurate (also wearable by the player)
Gameplay balancing for item stats, merchant inventories and survival stats.

On behalf of the entire team at Semaphore. Thank you so much for a great first year on Steam Early Access. Our community is our fuel and you guys and girls are the best!

Ahmad Jadallah (@AhmadJadallah)
Director of Development

notes.title: Badiya Alpha 1.6 is here! Performance Boost and Jumping!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

So as we promised Alpha 1.6 is here and this time we focused mainly on optimizing the game with two goals in mind:

- Increasing the frame rate without sacrificing the look of the game.
- Keeping frame rate consistent and avoiding dips and stutters.

The game defaults to Ultra quality setting, if you switch to High you will notice a further performance increase without much visual difference.

In addition, we added jumping (in place, while walking and while running) with corresponding effort and body movement sfx. This is a step toward more agility features such as climbing obstacles, walls, vaulting over fences and climbing ladders which should be coming in Alpha 1.7.

In the upcoming Alpha 1.7 we will also introduce the Quest System, Map System and POI Compass which will make exploring the environment a lot more engaging and rewarding.

As always please let us know your experience and share your feedback and bug reports on the email: feedback@semaphorelab.com

Best Regards,
Ahmad Jadallah (@AhmadJadallah)
Director of Development
Semaphore Lab (@SemaphoreLab)

[*] The loading screen now clarifies that you need to build a "Tent" or a "Lean-To " and save your game manually from them.
[*] Exit dialog window tells you that unsaved progress will be lost.

notes.title: Badiya Alpha 1.5 Status Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We wanted to give you a status update on Alpha 1.5. As most of you know this update is our biggest yet and it brings some of the most requested features including:

- Combat AI: Enemies (bandits/soldiers) that guard most of the Points of Interest in the desert. We designed the system so that you can either fight them gun blazing or stealth your way through with stealth takedowns and body dragging to avoid detection.

- Building System: You can now start building your own camp and fill it with items such as tent, campfire, cooking station, crafting bench, processing station, smelting station, item storage boxes, water containers and others. Tents will be where you do manual saving now (no more auto save on quit)

- More animals: We added many new wild and prey animals to make the desert more alive and diverse. Wild animals will appear more at night and they can appear in packs so that makes the night more dangerous.

- Balanced the items and survival gameplay so that you have more items to collect that you can process to gain more valuable items to sell or use including different minerals (Gold Ore, Copper Ore, etc..). We even added more hardcore survival items such as a wooden knife, bone knife and a rock knife. Hunger and thirst meters are more forgiving now as well.

So the good news is that development is done and we even finished making the trailer that we usually do for every release. What's holding us now is simply bug fixes so that you get the best experience possible. We are dedicating this week for the final round of bug fixing and our target release is next week and we will update this thread with more info soon.

We would like to thank you for your continuous support and the best is yet to come for Badiya!

Best Regards,

notes.title: Alpha 1.4.1 is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Note: If you like what we are doing, kindly leave us a positive review in the steam user reviews section. It really helps us :)

Alpha 1.4.1 is now live and it fixes a couple of issues we had with last week's Alpha 1.4 which featured many frequently requested features and performance optimizations including:

[h1]* Saving the location of any vehicle and rideable animal:[/h1]
You can now take a horse, camel, vehicle, tank and cross any distance with it. If you quit and load the game you will find it next to you along with its stats and inventory.

Keep in mind though that:
1- Vehicle upgrades cannot be saved currently (Will be fixed later)
2- The save will apply only to the last animal/vehicle you were riding (doesn't matter if you were in it or not)

For example, you take a horse from a bedouin camp and ride it a certain distance and leave it, then go back on foot to the camp and take a camel and go back to where you left the horse, only the camel and its inventory will be saved (if you wanted the horse you will ride it before you exit the game so that it is saved and not the camel). This is just temporary fix for now and later on we will work out a system that saves everything.


[h1]* Weather System fully upgraded:[/h1] 
We now support Volumetric Clouds, Thunder, Heat Haze and Solar Eclipse. 

[h1]* Cinematic Temporal Anti Aliasing: [/h1] 
In addition to the existing FXAA and SMAA Antialiasing methods, we now introduced Cinematic Temporal Anti Aliasing. The benefit of it is that you won't get the flickering and shimmering effect usually seen in games on things like vegetation, grass and fences.

[h1]* Filmic Look:[/h1] 
We are using a new color grading and correction effect that will give the game a more filmic look. We will be experimenting with more styles in the future to see which one is more suitable for the game.

[h1]* Contact Shadows:[/h1] 
Contact Shadows add extra detailed shading on all models and vegetation that makes them feel more grounded and detailed. Currently they are tied to "High" and "Ultra" quality presets but can be turned on or off separately if needed.

Here are screenshots to show the effect in action. The first screen shot is without contact shadows and the second is with them
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/16222083/Badiya/ss2.jpg
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/16222083/Badiya/ss1.jpg

[h1]* Ammo Calibers:[/h1] 
Each weapon will now have it's own ammo caliber (The stats of the weapon should tell you what caliber it requires.

[h1]* Wolf:[/h1] 
Our first enemy in the game! Wolves will appear during the day but more at night. They are tough opponents that you don't want to mess with. Generally you should try to avoid them if you don't have enough health packs and weapons/ammo.

We will be adding more wild animal types soon.

[h1]* Key Rebinding:[/h1] 
You can now change the default keyboard/mouse assignment for each action.

[h1]* Big Improvements in performance:[/h1] 
You should expect at least 50% in performance increase across the board. Keep in mind however that optimization is an ongoing process. There are some known slow down locations (Riding vehicles, while terrain generation happens in the desert, in large crowded villages) and those are our next targets for optimization.

[h1]* Vehicles Balancing:[/h1] 
- Vehicles that you find will start with different health and fuel amounts. So you will pobably need to repair the vehicles using scrap metal or fuel it up before driving.
- Vehicles that you find will now have a limited amount of ammo. Once this depletes you have to put ammo in it through it's inventory (Face the vehicle and press the inventory button. This will open up double inventory, simple give .303 caliber ammo to to the vehicle inventory and it will be ready for use.
- There is now an overheating meter that will prevent firing infinitely.
- Increased the accuracy of the machine gun on tanks and vehicles.

[h1]* Smaller Fixes:[/h1] 
- Improved hand animations when walking and running with more relaxed arm and hand poses
- All weapon holding poses are now fixed
- Fixed Oasis Water Color
- Added a room in the airstrip that contains lootable boxes.

[h1]* Gameplay Tweaks:[/h1] 
In order to improve the quality and challenge of gameplay we made tweaks to Time of Day Progression Speed, Hunger, Thirst and Stamina Depletion, Fuel Consumption.

Keep in mind though that:
1- Vehicle upgrades cannot be saved currently (Will be fixed later)
2- The save will apply only to the last animal/vehicle you were riding (doesn't matter if you were in it or not)

notes.title: Patch 1.3 is now live! Check out the Release Notes here
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Patch 1.3 is now live and it features a host of additions, improvements and bug fixes. We listen very carefully to your feedback and many thanks for everyone who reported on their issues.

Here are the release notes:

[h1]* General:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Game executable was not working in some cases. This had to do with saving data location. Now it's fixed.
[*]Add version number to the top right corner of in-game all the time
[*]Performance Optimization in villages.
[*]Fixed Camera occlusion issues (Collision with the environment).
[*]Overall balancing of item values and crafting components
[*]Oasis used to play water footstep sounds before you reach the actual water surface.
[*]Fixed issues with dying while sleeping
[*]Oil field is now animated, has industrial props and utility loot surrounding it, and plays proper machinery sounds.
[*]Reduced the foot SFX of the horse/camel walking/running on rain/snow to half the current value
[*]Sand accumulation was happening during snow. Now fixed.
[*]Temperatures now are accurate throughout the year. Temperature will increase during day and decrease at night.
[*]Replace "Y" for interaction 2 with "Q". Closer to the left hand.
[*]Allow horse and camel to go over tiles in the air strip.
[*]Made "Cloud Shadows" an optional feature that should be turned off on "Low" preset only
[/list]

[h1]* Menus:[/h1]
[list]
[*]You can now see the value of each slider in the menus (FOV slider, audio sliders, etc...)
[*]On loot boxes/merchants/vehicles added an icon to indicate "All"
[*]Player inventory starts with 50 KG capacity, capacity can be increased when you equip a solider backpack (20 kg additional) or an explorer bag (10 kg additional)
[*]In crafting menu, when an item is needed and you don't have enough of it, we write the amount that you have so 3/5 in red colors means you don't have enough yet but you have 3. So you know right away how many more you need.
[*]In crafting menu, we write the name of the crafting component that is needed so you don't have to guess what the item icon means.
[*]When you are using a mouse and hovering over an item you see a box containing the "Stats and Condition" of that item.
[*]Hover over Salvage and Crafting components (in crafting menu and inventory item window at bottom) and you get a tool tip showing their name 
[*]Fixed a bug where the scroller in crafting window snaps to bottom all the time 
[/list]

[h1]* Player:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Adjusted overall stamina depletion rate to be more realistic.
[*]Added looking around animations that happen while walking. This helps break the walk cycle look and make it more natural.
[*]When unlock a box then close the window, make the player stand up automatically
[*]Fixed fingernails appearing black sometimes
[/list]

[h1]* Weapons:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Cross hair will now become red to indicate if you are aiming on your target.
[*]All weapons now have dispersion. Your accuracy while moving is going to be lower than if you are standing still. The cross hair will move to indicate that.
[*]Fixed an issue where after shooting the Luger or revolver, the gun doesn't immediately return to its position.
Thompson and MP18 automatic firing is working properly now.
[/list]


[h1]* Interactivity:[/h1] 
[list]
[*]Hitting metal fences and columns in the airport (while driving a car or a tank) will make them fall if you moving at a high speed.
[*]Added several gas tanks, explosive barrels, and water barrels in the airport. Those are all interactive and will have different behavior when shot. Check them out :)
[*]Punching wooden or clay props or using a tool to hit them with will cause them to break
[/list]

[h1]* Coming Up Next:[/h1] 
[list]
This is just a sample of the features coming up next.

[*]Key Rebinding .
[*]Quick Access Bar (Hot Bar) at the bottom which you can drag items to and access with a single key press on keyboard.
[*] Photo Mode: Frame your shot, change the filters and effects and take that awesome screenshot.
[*]Localized Subtitles for all speech.
[*]Saving the location of all vehicles and rideable animals in the place you were in.
[*]Wild Animals that can attack the player. Starting with a wolf.
[*] Different ammo calibers for each of the weapons in the game. So no more unified ammo for all weapons.
[/list]

notes.title: Badiya Alpha 1 is Coming November 11th to Early Access
notes.notes:
This is it! The journey starts this Friday the 11th of November with the release of Badiya Alpha 1 on Steam Early Access. 

We announced Badiya in April of this year with a reveal trailer that demonstrated our overall vision for the game. An infinite procedural open world set in the desert post World War 1 where your primary goal is to survive both the environment and the elements.

Badiya got a great reception from the community worldwide and the game was shown at the PC Gaming Show at E3 2016. Since then, the game appeared in several "top most anticipated games of 2016" videos on Youtube (6 so far with a total of 7 million views and counting).

Now Alpha 1 will be the first time the game gets in the hands of a large group of gamers to experience the core mechanics we laid out: Exploration, Looting, Crafting, Cooking, Trading, Hunting, Riding of Animals and driving vehicles and Inventory management. You can take a look at the full current and planned feature list on this link [url=http://semaphorelab.com/en/badiya/] Here [/url].

We coupled Badiya's gameplay features with a unique technical backbone supporting high end features you typically find in AAA games. Our rendering pipeline is based on Physically Based Rendering which takes into account the real life material properties of the all the different surfaces involved in any given object. A full day/night cycle is present along with a variety of weather conditions including Rain, Snow, Sand Storms and many others.
A full cinematic post processing chain provides features such as GI simulation (color bleeding), post processing, grain, vignetting, chromatic abberation, depth of field along with several choices for Anti aliasing like FXAA, SMAA, and Temporal Antialiasing that eliminates shimmering on distant objects resulting in a cleaner and stable overall image. 

Badiya provides procedural destruction on props and objects that take into account the properties of the weapon you are shooting with and the angle of shooting. In addition, we provide long leaves touch bending on short palms so that leaves actually bend when you go through them instead of going inside the character. 

Badiya Alpha 1 provides full support for 4K resolution with a user interface that scales nicely and looks sharp. Alpha 1 provides (in addition to keyboard and mouse) full support for Xbox One and PS4 controller which you can switch to at any point on the fly. Keybinding is next on our list!

We look forward to welcoming you on this journey and look forward to your feedback to shape it up to be the ultimate survival experience.
